title: Da km/h a m/s
code:
import pint
u = pint.UnitRegistry()
v = (72 * u.km / u.hour).to(u.m / u.s)
print(round(v.magnitude, 1), v.units)
codeHtml: import pint u = pint.UnitRegistry() v = (72 * u.km / u.hour).to(u.m / u.s) print(round(v.magnitude, 1), v.units)
explain: 72 km/h = 72 000 m / 3600 s = 20 m/s. .to() converte e controlla che le dimensioni siano compatibili.
